title: Casper and the Gravity
author: Emrys Eastwick
blurb: Ines Dunmore, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
